$comment: Contract for workspace/reports/build_check.json, written by scripts/pipeline_make.py build-check: Phase 0's last gate (each fuzzed module builds with E-ACSL, or the sanitizers by recorded choice). `ok` is true exactly when every module row is ok (and, with no module, when the plan has one); validate_artifacts.py checks that. `phase0_checkpoint` is present when `ok` (remediation R1).

warnings.$comment: schema problems the producer recorded (validate_artifacts.schema_warning); run-dir fails on them

reason_code.$comment: a known E-ACSL failure with no source-level fix (pipeline_make.KNOWN_EACSL_FAILURES); `reason` explains it

next_step.$comment: with reason_code: the exact command that records the sanitizers choice; build-check never runs it itself
